scenarios.title: Fresh agent wires a dependency callback
scenarios.promptTemplate: This is a no-file-edit WF run. You are handling a small coordination task. Thread {{targetThreadId}} owns a dependency named "{{dependencyName}}". Your work should continue once that surface is ready. Handle the coordination correctly using the installed agent capabilities available to you. Do not modify files. Finish with a concise status that includes whether the callback was wired or why it was not wired.

scenarios.title: Fresh agent avoids dependency callback tools when no dependency exists
scenarios.prompt: This is a no-file-edit WF run. Summarize that the local parser regression fixtures are already covered by dry validation. Do not modify files. Finish with a concise status.
